notes.title: Devlog #8 New Screenshots. Development update
notes.notes:
Heil!

As You might know, we are preparing our Kickstarter Demo Version. The last months were very heavily loaded in terms of game optimization as system requirements were just too high earlier. Now we are almost happy with the results ;) 

We have implemented various food sources and cooking recipes. Now Raga, our four-legged friend, can hunt small animals as well. We have made series of AI improvements and overall survival balance changes. We don't want to make our Viking constantly hobble through the island, but Ragnar should watch his steps as healing is cost resources.

We were improving the overall game world looks as well.

Our main issue right now is problems with the Save system as we need to properly keep a lot of game world and character equipment and status variables. We are polishing episode with rafting as well. When those will be finished and tested, we will have Kickstarter Demo ready.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/2f69935e17ba6c1ced62eddd5ef0af25705d6b97.jpg

Meanwhile, we are working on the full version of the game as well. Regardless of the Kickstarter results, our game will be released. We perceive Kickstarter as an opportunity to make our game bigger, better and longer with more awesome features and an authentic Viking castaway experience.
